Name: pre-cluster-threshold
Description: Detection threshold to be applied prior to clustering operation

Name: post-cluster-threshold
Description: Detection threshold to be applied post clustering operation

Name: eps
Description: Epsilon values for OpenCV grouprectangles() function and DBSCAN algorithm

Name: group-threshold
Description: Threshold value for rectangle merging for OpenCV grouprectangles() function

Name: minBoxes
Description: Minimum number of points required to form a dense region for DBSCAN algorithm

Name: dbscan-min-score
Description: Minimum sum of confidence of all the neighbors in a cluster for it to be considered a valid cluster.

Name: nms-iou-threshold
Description: Maximum IOU score between two proposals after which the proposal with the lower confidence will be rejected.

Name: roi-top-offset
Description: Offset of the RoI from the top of the frame. Only objects within the RoI are output.

Name: roi-bottom-offset
Description: Offset of the RoI from the bottom of the frame. Only objects within the RoI are output.

Name: detected-min-w
Description: Minimum width in pixels of detected objects to be output by the GIE

Name: detected-min-h
Description: Minimum height in pixels of detected objects to be output by the GIE

Name: detected-max-w
Description: Maximum width in pixels of detected objects to be output by the GIE

Name: detected-max-h
Description: Maximum height in pixels of detected objects to be output by the GIE

Name: topk
Description: Keep only top K objects with highest detection scores.
